title: ERNIE 4.5 Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型后训练与反馈系统技术报告
best_for_zh: 研究混合奖励、偏好优化、多模态 RLVR 与前沿模型披露审计的读者
one_line: ERNIE 4.5 reports a 2.3M-sample LLM SFT corpus, heterogeneous verifier/reward stack, PPO-based progressive RL with UPO, and a three-stage VLM SFT-to-RLVR pipeline, but does not release the underlying post-training ledger.
ERNIE 4.5 披露了 230 万条 LLM SFT、异构验证器/奖励栈、基于 PPO 与 UPO 的渐进 RL，以及三阶段 VLM SFT-to-RLVR 流水线，但未发布底层后训练账本。
why: It is an unusually concrete frontier recipe for combining rule verification, learned judges, pairwise preference signals and multimodal environments, while showing where family-level disclosure still falls short of reproducible data lineage.
inclusion_reason: A detailed frontier-model disclosure of how reasoning/non-reasoning SFT, heterogeneous reward systems, preference optimization and multimodal RLVR are combined, while exposing important release and lineage gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html: Frontier model reports often name SFT or RL without exposing the data object or feedback contract. ERNIE 4.5 is useful because its report goes further: it separates language and vision-language post-training and specifies how reasoning traces, preference pairs, rule verifiers, learned judges, sandboxes, and multimodal environments interact. The audit question is not whether ERNIE 4.5 was post-trained, but which disclosed mechanisms are reproducible and which remain family-level descriptions without released records.
前沿模型报告常常只列出 SFT 或 RL 名称，却不说明数据对象与反馈契约。ERNIE 4.5 的价值在于更进一步：报告区分语言模型与视觉语言模型的后训练，并说明推理轨迹、偏好对、规则验证器、学习式评审器、沙箱和多模态环境如何协同。这里的审计重点不是“是否做过后训练”，而是哪些机制已有可复核披露，哪些仍停留在家族级描述且没有对应记录发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ERNIE 4.5 uses modality-specific post-training. The LLM pipeline trains on 2.3 million SFT samples, then applies PPO-based progressive RL and Unified Preference Optimization (UPO) against a heterogeneous reward system. The VLM pipeline constructs perception and reasoning traces through synthesis, recaptioning, rejection sampling, and thinking/non-thinking fusion, then applies verifiable-reward training on visual STEM, puzzles, and UI-to-code tasks. The central data contribution is therefore a recipe for routing different task types to different feedback contracts—not a released unified dataset.

ERNIE 4.5 采用模态专用后训练。LLM 流水线先使用 230 万条 SFT 样本，再基于异构奖励系统执行 PPO 式渐进强化学习与统一偏好优化（UPO）。VLM 流水线通过合成、重描述、拒绝采样以及思考/非思考融合构造感知与推理轨迹，随后在视觉 STEM、视觉谜题和 UI-to-code 任务上采用可验证奖励训练。因此，其核心数据贡献是一套把不同任务路由到不同反馈契约的配方，而不是一个已发布的统一数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
For LLM SFT, the report groups data into ten topical domains and separates reasoning from non-reasoning tasks. Some reasoning queries receive multiple responses with distinct chains; the resulting 2.3M-sample corpus is trained for about two epochs. The reward stack uses rule verifiers, reference-guided LLM-as-a-judge, a code sandbox, and a reference-guided discriminative reward model for reasoning; open-ended tasks use checklist-aware verifiers, generative reward models, and discriminative reward models. PPO-based progressive RL proceeds from logic to math/code and then to a general mixture. UPO adds a DPO pairwise loss to PPO: online UPO rejection-samples pairs from multiple responses during each iteration, whereas offline UPO pre-generates them. Prompts with verifier accuracy 0 or 1 and groups with little reward variance are removed; rewards are separated by source and domain and normalized independently.

VLM post-training has three SFT stages. It synthesizes puzzles, geometry, and mathematical-function images, and recaptions natural STEM images; a caption is retained only when repeated text-only inference recovers the correct answer, while OCR-solvable samples are removed. Text-only reasoning provides a cold start after agent/rule filtering; rejection sampling then creates multimodal trajectories, and successful RL trajectories are recycled into SFT. Thinking and non-thinking data are mixed, with empty masked thinking tags for non-reasoning records, and experts are merged. RLVR covers open and proprietary K-12 visual STEM, more than 10K synthetic puzzles, and UI2Code/Image2Struct. Puzzle answers require two LLM judges to agree; UI2Code compares rendered HTML with a reference image. Hybrid VLM RL combines these verifiers with a Bradley-Terry multimodal reward model and GRPO with dynamic sampling and overlong filtering.

LLM 的 SFT 数据被划分为十个主题域，并进一步区分推理与非推理任务。部分推理查询配有多条不同思维链的回答，最终形成 230 万条样本，平均训练约两个 epoch。推理任务的奖励栈包括规则验证器、参考答案引导的 LLM-as-a-judge、代码沙箱和参考答案引导的判别式奖励模型；开放式任务则使用清单感知验证器、生成式奖励模型和判别式奖励模型。基于 PPO 的渐进强化学习依次训练逻辑、数学/代码以及通用混合任务。UPO 在 PPO 中加入 DPO 成对偏好损失：在线 UPO 在每轮从同一查询的多条回答中拒绝采样偏好对，离线 UPO 则在 RL 前预生成偏好数据。对于可验证数据，准确率为 0 或 1 的提示以及组内奖励方差过低的样本组会被移除；不同来源和主题域的奖励被拆分并独立归一化。

VLM 后训练包含三个 SFT 阶段。流水线合成谜题、几何图和数学函数图，并对自然 STEM 图像重新生成细粒度描述；只有当文本模型多次仅凭描述都能答对时才保留样本，同时删除仅靠 OCR 即可作答的记录。经代理式与规则式过滤的纯文本推理数据用于冷启动，随后通过拒绝采样产生多模态轨迹，并把 RL 中持续发现的优质轨迹回流到 SFT。最后混合思考与非思考数据：非推理回答前置被 mask 的空思考标签，并结合专家合并。RLVR 覆盖开放及专有 K-12 视觉 STEM、超过 1 万道合成视觉谜题，以及 UI2Code/Image2Struct。谜题回答须由两个 LLM 评审同时判定正确；UI2Code 则比较生成 HTML 的渲染结果与参考图像。VLM 的混合 RL 将这些验证器与采用 Bradley–Terry 目标训练的多模态奖励模型结合，并使用带动态采样和超长过滤的 GRPO。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The report directly supports the 2.3M LLM SFT count, two-epoch average, reward components, three-stage progressive RL, online/offline UPO construction, RL prompt filters, and the VLM data/verification pipeline. It also reports benchmark gains across instruction following, reasoning, multimodal understanding, and thinking mode, but those scores do not by themselves validate data quality. The official release and repository independently confirm downloadable ERNIE 4.5 weights, inference code, ERNIEKit SFT/DPO examples, and Apache-2.0 model/repository licensing. No official item-level SFT, preference, reward-model, or RL dataset was located.

报告直接支持以下事实：LLM SFT 共 230 万条样本、平均训练两个 epoch、异构奖励组件、三阶段渐进 RL、在线/离线 UPO 的偏好对构造方式、RL 提示过滤规则，以及 VLM 的数据与验证流程。报告还给出了指令遵循、推理、多模态理解和思考模式等基准结果，但分数本身不能证明数据质量。官方发布页与代码仓库另行确认了可下载的 ERNIE 4.5 权重、推理代码、ERNIEKit 的 SFT/DPO 示例以及模型和仓库的 Apache-2.0 许可。本次未找到官方发布的逐条 SFT、偏好、奖励模型或 RL 数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The distinctive contribution is the explicit matching between task epistemology and feedback: strict reasoning tasks favor rules, references, sandboxes, and discriminative scoring; open-ended tasks use checklist and learned reward models; multimodal tasks add answer verification, dual-judge puzzle checks, and rendered-UI comparison. UPO further combines scalar PPO rewards with pairwise DPO signals, while per-source/domain normalization addresses heterogeneous reward scales. This is more informative than merely naming an RL algorithm, although it remains a report-level recipe rather than a fully released training ledger.

其突出贡献是把任务的可判定性质与反馈机制明确对应：严格推理任务优先使用规则、参考答案、沙箱和判别式评分；开放任务使用清单与学习式奖励模型；多模态任务再加入答案验证、双评审谜题判定和 UI 渲染对比。UPO 进一步把 PPO 的标量奖励与 DPO 的成对偏好信号结合，而按来源和主题域归一化则用于处理异构奖励尺度。相比只列出某种 RL 算法，这些披露更具审计价值，但它仍是一套报告级配方，而非完整发布的训练账本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The 2.3M SFT set, preference pairs, reward-model training records, RL rollouts, and per-variant manifests are not released. The report does not provide complete source proportions, splits, decontamination, rollout counts, sampling temperatures, reward calibration, or most optimizer settings. Some VLM inputs come from proprietary K-12 resources, and licenses for underlying post-training records remain undisclosed. Learned judges and online rejection sampling can inherit model-specific bias; family-level descriptions also cannot establish which exact data/objective combination produced each released checkpoint.
230 万条 SFT 数据、偏好对、奖励模型训练记录、RL rollout 以及逐模型变体清单均未发布。报告没有给出完整来源比例、数据划分、去污染、rollout 数量、采样温度、奖励校准和大部分优化超参数。部分 VLM 输入来自专有 K-12 教育资源，底层后训练记录的许可也未披露。学习式评审器和在线拒绝采样可能继承特定模型偏差；家族级描述也无法证明每个已发布检查点究竟使用了哪组数据和目标。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This Card is useful for designing auditable mixed-feedback pipelines. It shows how to record the prompt family, trace form, verifier or judge, preference construction, filtering, normalization, and terminal predicate separately for each task type. It also provides a practical comparison point for PPO+DPO hybrids, multimodal RLVR, and recycling successful RL trajectories into SFT, while clearly marking which disclosures are insufficient for exact reproduction.
本卡适合用于设计可审计的混合反馈流水线。它展示了如何针对每类任务分别记录提示来源、轨迹形式、验证器或评审器、偏好构造、过滤、归一化与终止条件；也可作为 PPO+DPO 混合优化、多模态 RLVR、以及把成功 RL 轨迹回流到 SFT 的对照案例，同时明确指出哪些披露仍不足以支持精确复现。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read pp.14–17 for the LLM SFT, unified reward system, progressive PPO, UPO, and reward normalization.
  • Read pp.17–19 for VLM synthesis, rejection sampling, thinking/non-thinking fusion, and RLVR environments.
  • Treat the 2.3M SFT count as a reported training corpus, not a public dataset release.
  • Separate Apache-2.0 model/code licensing from the undisclosed rights of post-training records.

• 第 14–17 页集中说明 LLM SFT、统一奖励系统、渐进 PPO、UPO 与奖励归一化。
  • 第 17–19 页集中说明 VLM 合成、拒绝采样、思考/非思考融合与 RLVR 环境。
  • “230 万条 SFT”是报告中的训练规模，不等于公开数据集。
  • 应把模型/代码的 Apache-2.0 许可与未披露的后训练记录权利分开审计。
